descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S01 「医院：三个病人的任务（一个已完成）在一个界面上、在 Copy Text 里，没有 email」 Hospital: three patients' tasks, one completed, on one screen and in Copy Text, no email

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician in Hospital with three seeded patients and six tasks (one already done); one Nursing Home resident with an open task as a bleed probe

When Open the Hospital list → Task Export; tick 'Follow up blood cultures' as done; expand the completed section if it is collapsed; tap Copy Text. The scripted step then reads the clipboard

Then One screen lists the four open tasks, each under its own patient, then the two completed ones at the bottom, each with its patient; no Email control; the clipboard has the same grouping, pending first and completed at the bottom; nothing from the Nursing Home resident

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From UAT TC-07 Steps 1–4 and Expected bullets 1 and 6, AC 2–4 and 11. cp1: mustContain every name and task and 'Copy Text'; mustNotContain 'Email', 'mailto', 'undefined' and the probe; groupedUnder for the pending tasks; attributedTo for the completed ones; same-patient pending-before-completed pairs (Ben, Cara). …

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 failed 改成 broken。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92585 ready for pr

医院的任务导出页上能看到已完成的任务，但 Copy Text 只复制了未完成的，已完成的全漏了。

On the Hospital task export, completed tasks show on screen but Copy Text leaves them out; it copies only the open tasks.

依据：datasets lane known-gap: the completed block is in PR #106, not on main. TFA-92585 is ready for pr, and per UAT §4 every TC-07 requirement is gated, so this ran anyway. The on-screen open-above-completed order is recorded for Q5.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本（PW (clipboard through grantPermissions and clipboard.readText; grouping by locator)）；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev/datasets。
